description: List the app-level moderators (per-app user ids). App moderators manage rooms of any type and moderate the community. They are the members of the app's reserved group `moderators`, which lives in its data: a pre on pro's data has pro's, a pre with its own data its own (empty at first; env "pre" to see it).

env.description: Whose moderators: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (its own unless it plays with pro's data)

name: neblla_list_moderators
